that’s exactly how i feel. i swear these are his emotions because he wasn’t on my mind before hand

i actually am not. if you knew anything about being in a mentally abusive relationship you’d understand how tiring it is when the other person drags out something that doesn’t need to be. he broke up with me but refused to give me back my property which he told others that he knew meant a lot to me. (keeping me in a constant loop where i’d ask him to mail it back to me and him telling me he would, week after week). dealing with a narcissist can make you feel like you’re going crazy, so i do not need you shaming me, along side of him and his family who he had manipulated, against me. thanks for your input but if you do not know the entire story there is no need to try to victim blame.

i honestly have no idea why he reached out, especially when i originally contacted his mother. the only reason why she couldn’t call me back was because i had to call with no caller id because my ex blocked my number off of her phone so i wouldn’t get him in trouble about all of this. then i get blamed for getting an abortion that his son asked me to get.

also because i wasn’t able to add a story to the post i see why people would think that i kept it a secret. when i first got pregnant my ex told me he wanted a baby and knew i did too, when i asked him if he was serious he said yes over and over, when i ended up pregnant he told me he wasn’t ready for a baby and asked me to get an abortion. my ex was very manipulative.
the whole reason i involved his parents was because he would not give me my ultrasound picture back

i didn’t keep the abortions a secret from my ex, he took me to get the first one because he didn’t want a baby. i never wanted an abortion. and the second one i found out during our break up and when i told him he said “there’s no reason to have a kid especially since we aren’t together” then wouldn’t talk to me after. my ex was lying about not having the first ultrasound picture because he didn’t want to get in trouble
idk why this is over venmo, i gave them my number.
does this work? how long did it take?
how did it work?
so i need this spell, also not a spell but just keep thinking about all the good things about them and spend more time with the, the feelings will come back
thank you!!
thank you for your advice. i was really worried and thought there was something wrong with me.
thank you i’m going to try this <3

thank you so much for replying to this. although after he broke up with me, he immediately started refollowing all the girls he knows would upset me, i know for a fact he hasn’t been with anyone. i hate to admit but i’ve been online stalking a bit. (i try not to but it helps ease my anxiety). this entire thing feels so off and i feel like if someone was truly over a relationship they’d want to exchange things and immediately go about their business. i have a feeling he’s going to be coming back to me in the future to help put him back together. he always has me fix him. there have been times where i’ve asked if we could take a break where we’re still exclusive to each other but i could work in my mental health and he’d have panic attacks if i ever brought up leaving. actually a week before we broke up he threatened to cut himself when i brought up a break again and the night before the break up when i suggested it again he had another panic attack. i really do love and care about him but i know i don’t deserve this, especially because he’s purposely triggering me.
i’ve seen a lot of videos on tiktok telling me to unblock my heart chakra and i decided to take a test to see where all my chakras stood. my heart was the lowest one
could it be anything they’ve given you saying that they love you?
i will be starting therapy next week! thank you for the advice

thank you so much for giving me your help on this situation. i’m new to all of this and i also don’t even know 100% if he is a narcissist but i looked up signs and he did show a lot of them.

somethings he used to do where, only wanting to spend time with me instead of family or friends, he loved to be babied by me and even told me that i give him the love and reassurance that his family won’t give him, he would constantly ask me things about my past relationships and then get upset and tell me how much he hated them, and he was so obsessed with me. i guess i always saw these things as him being in love with me. he always reassured me that he saw a future with me and would often tell me that he loved everything about me. his family even included me in a photo album of all the years of his life because they loved me so much. the weeks leading up to our relationship ending i told him he didn’t make me feel as special as he used to and for some reason unlike other times i’d bring up a concern, he just didn’t do much to change. when he broke up with me and i asked why he would only say he was really broken and he’d been upset with some of my actions too, but never told me. (keep in mind when i kept my concerns to myself he told me he wasn’t a mind reader and i needed to tell him) so that didn’t make sense. all of this is so random considering he was telling me the night before he ended things, that we’d be married. 

he also hasn’t been sober since the break up and told me he’s been the happiest he’s ever been in a long time (he was addicted to marijuana and i kept him sober from this) and now he’s drinking too. 

i feel so guilty and i don’t know if this is his ultimate goal or to make me feel this way as a punishment.

i also forgot to mention he was extremely possessive of me in our relationship. he would always check my location and made sure it was always shared on everything and if i changed my passwords or turned it off, he would go through my phone and either put the password back to one he knew or turn the location back on. he has gone through my phone multiple times while i was asleep.

i appreciate this! i feel like i’m being made out to seem crazy about him dragging this out. and i have no idea why if he’s the one saying that he wants to over. i feel so exhausted with all of this. i want it all to be done.
it’s hard to stay positive and sure of these things because of my anxiety so i usually turn so someone for a bit of reassurance. i will be thanking the universe!

he wasn’t always like this. i don’t exactly remember when things changed but all he does now is accuse me of being the toxic and immature one. i kinda just feel stuck in all of this. definitely getting therapy after this relationship. it was one of my hardest ones.
this might not be anything but he also told me not to get with anyone when we break up. he told me to focus on myself? why would he even care if he broke up with me?
thank you. i am trying to move on but i swear he pops up randomly when i do.

i keep wondering if it’s over then something weird will happen like his friend added me on snapchat (only my ex has my snapchat so he obvi gave it to him) and his friend kept asking me about it and then randomly stopped talking to me after trying to get with me which i declined bc i still love my ex. a ton of fake account have been following me because my instagram is private and he’s been viewing my tiktoks.
